data.title: Keep Todoist capture independent from Apple Mail Vault
data.context: Mail-to-vault ingestion owns archival, durable EML capture, queueing, and canonical vault proof, while task capture owns credentials, a Todoist write, duplicate protection, and HUD feedback.
data.decision: Maintain apple-mail-todoist as a standalone public repository with no JSONL Vault runtime dependency.
consequences: The Todoist workflow cannot affect mail archival or vault ingest.
A small Mail selection adapter is duplicated until multiple consumers justify a shared package.

data.title: Use direct Todoist API creation for the primary UX
data.context: The desired interaction is one keystroke with lightweight confirmation rather than a prefilled Quick Add form.
data.decision: Create explicit Inbox tasks through Todoist API v1 and report a typed outcome through a Raycast HUD.
consequences: The token requires Keychain-backed setup and redaction.
Idempotency and reconciliation are product requirements, not optional hardening.

data.title: Use authoritative local gates instead of GitHub Actions
data.context: Repository policy avoids GitHub Actions while public-readiness still requires reproducible quality evidence.
data.decision: Use make check backed by scripts/validate_repository.py as the single local gate.
consequences: Fresh-clone and release verification must record local command evidence.
